title: The perfect housewarming gift
text: The perfect housewarming gift. This 7-piece utensil set with enameled stoneware crock is a perfect housewarming gift or a great starter investment for students heading off to college. To be honest, I mostly wanted the set for the utensil crock, as I have searched unsuccessfully for one large enough and sturdy enough to hold my everyday whisks and spatulas, and the Le Creuset stoneware crock is large enough to double as a makeshift vase or wine cooler (the stoneware cools down quickly) in a pinch. The utensils are extraordinarily handy, particularly if you're always having to hunt for a spatula (or can't find one that's the right size). They're perfect for nonstick cookware, and withstand up to 800-degree heat. The silicone heads are detachable for (fairly) easy cleaning. The only thing that would have made this set perfect was the inclusion of a silicone whisk, a necessity for stirring sauces and liquid ingredients in nonstick saucepans. Otherwise, this is a great value, and you're sure to get years of use from the included spatulas.

product_metadata.title: Le Creuset Silicone 7-Piece Utensil Set, White
features: 7-piece spatula set for scraping, mixing, serving, basting, and more
Includes basting brush, 5 spatulas, and a 1-quart matching stoneware crock
Stain-resistant, non-abrasive Silicone heads; heat-resistant up to 482 degrees F
Stay-cool wood handles; dishwasher-safe heads; made in the USA
description: A useful addition to any cook's arsenal of tools, this seven-piece spatula set comes in handy for scraping, mixing, serving, basting, and more. The set consists of a basting brush, five spatulas (a small spatula, medium spatula, large spatula spoon, mini spatula, and a jumbo slotted spatula spoon), and a 1-quart matching stoneware crock that sits sturdily on the countertop, keeping the tools neatly contained and at the ready. Each tool features a comfortable stay-cool wood handle with a high-quality Silicone head that won't scratch nonstick pans and that can withstand heat up to 482 degrees F (250 degrees C). Use the spatulas for mixing ingredients, serving a main course or side, getting the last bit of cookie dough out from the bowl, or spreading frosting on a chocolate birthday cake. For added convenience, the stain-resistant, non-abrasive Silicone heads remove from the wood handles for quick cleanup by hand or in the dishwasher. The collection comes in a clean white hue designed to effortlessly coordinate with Le Creuset cookware, but it works equally well with any other cookware brand. Made in the USA, the spatula set sports the Le Creuset name on the crock and on the handles, and it measures approximately 5 by 5 by 12 inches.

Although this crock and utensil set is designed to color-coordinate with Le Creuset cookware, the superb quality and choice of colors makes this a great gift for any cook, regardless of his or her cookware brand. The one-quart ceramic crock sits sturdily on the countertop and shows an attractive glaze pattern that fades from dark at the bottom to light at the flared top. Included are six tools with high-heat-resistant silicone heads that won't scratch nonstick pans and remove from the wooden handles for dishwasher cleaning.

An excellent multipurpose set for scraping, mixing, serving, and basting, the utensils include a basting brush and five spatulas: mini, small, medium, large spoon-shaped, and jumbo slotted spoon-shaped. Made in the USA, the set's wooden handles as well as the crock is emblazoned with the renowned Le Creuset name.
